how_read: scripts/kb/fetch_wiki_live_pages.py --api https://fallout.fandom.com/api.php --titles <pages> (page text as rendered by the wiki, link markup removed). Every quoted sentence below was checked, by script, to appear word for word in the page text read at the revision named. Every page used is the Fallout 4 page of its subject; no other Fallout game's page or section is used.

lines.line: Summary: A fast, flying mutant insect with a scorpion-like tail that ends in a deadly sting. You often meet them in swarms, in groups of up to five, and their erratic flying makes them formidable.

quoted: Stingwings appear to be large, mutated insects with extended mouthparts and a scorpion-like tail, ending in a bulbous and deadly sting.
They can often be found in swarms, and their erratic flying coupled with a venomous sting makes them formidable opponents.
They are often encountered in groups of up to five

lines.line: Weak points: It is fragile and can be taken down in relatively few shots even at mid-level, but it is extremely fast and hits fairly hard. Its speed and erratic movement make it very hard to hit without V.A.T.S.

quoted: Fragile but agile, the stingwing can be taken down in relatively few shots even at mid-level.
It is, however, extremely fast, hits fairly hard
which can combine to make them very hard to hit without V.A.T.S.

lines.line: Looks like: A large mutated insect with extended mouthparts and a scorpion-like tail ending in a bulbous sting. A glowing stingwing has a body that glows from absorbed radiation.

quoted: large, mutated insects with extended mouthparts and a scorpion-like tail, ending in a bulbous and deadly sting.
A version of the stingwing whose body glows due to an abundance of absorbed radiation.

lines.line: Tips: Expect a dive-bombing attack: it circles you, rushes in to hit once, then goes back to circling, and sometimes it rushes at you in single file. Their nests are large clusters on the ground and walls that ooze bright yellow sap, and when you approach one several stingwings come out to defend it. At higher levels the stingwing chaser, the toughest kind, is fast, hits hard and attacks together with its group.

quoted: fond of a "dive-bombing" tactic where it circles the player character and rushes in to hit once before returning to circling.
Another tactic the stingwing tends to use is to rush at the player character in single file.

They are known to build large clusters of nests on the ground and walls, with nests themselves oozing a bright yellow sap akin to honey from their entrances. When these nests are approached, multiple stingwings will emerge to fiercely defend them from potential threats.

Chasers can be considered as the toughest of the stingwing variants. They are fast, hit hard, and are especially dangerous when encountered in groups, as they will attack together. Once the Sole Survivor reaches higher levels, they will spawn in various areas.

lines.line: Summary: A fast, territorial burrowing rodent, found from the Red Rocket truck stop all the way to the Glowing Sea. Compared to many other enemies mole rats are generally weak, but a swarm can hide from your sight and attack from behind.

quoted: They are highly territorial and will attack anything entering their territory. They move quickly and will attack with a jumping lunge.

Mole rats are common pests in the wasteland, as they can be encountered as soon as the Red Rocket truck stop and as far as the Glowing Sea. Compared to many other enemies, mole rats are generally weak. However, if allowed to swarm, they may become a problem since they have the ability to easily hide from the player character's sight and attack from behind.

lines.line: Weak points: The standard mole rat has a mere 15 hit points and can be killed with a single hit from most weapons. A rabid mole rat is tougher and its bites fester, causing damage over time, but it remains a weak opponent.

quoted: With a mere 15 Hit Points, this enemy can be killed with a single hit from most weapons, making them more of a nuisance than a threat.
Bites from rabid mole rats fester, causing damage over time. They are tougher than standard mole rats, but remain weak opponents.

lines.line: Looks like: A bald, pink animal with large front teeth and small eyes, from the size of a house cat up to a large dog.

quoted: They range in size from a house cat up to a large dog and possibly bigger. They have a bald, pink appearance, with large front teeth and small eyes.

lines.line: Tips: Mole rats in the Commonwealth tunnel to avoid you or to close in unseen, but a faint outline of their tunnel can be seen as they move. They retreat into a tunnel if you stand somewhere they cannot reach, such as on top of a car. Some are landminers with fragmentation mines strapped to their backs, and those detonate on impact and hurt anything close.

quoted: They will tunnel to avoid their enemy or close in to attack unseen, they will also retreat to a tunnel if the player character moves to an area inaccessible to them, such as on top of a car.
However, a faint outline of their tunnel can be seen as they move.
it is possible to encounter mole rats with fragmentation mines strapped to their backs. These will detonate on impact, dealing damage to anything in proximity.

lines.line: Summary: A mutated mosquito that attacks in swarms, stabbing you with a needle-like proboscis and drinking your blood, then spitting the blood back at you for a large amount of radiation damage.

quoted: these mutated insects attack in swarms, piercing their prey with a needle-like proboscis and feeding on their blood.
The insect then becomes engorged with the victim's blood and can spit the contaminated blood back at its target for a large amount of radiation damage

lines.line: Weak points: Damaging its blood sac makes it lose its spit ability, though the sac is restored if it is given enough time. Its proboscis cannot get through power armor, so against power armor it is left with largely ineffectual stings and its acid spit.

quoted: Damaging the bloodbug's blood sac causes it to lose its spit ability, but the bloodbug can still suck the victim's blood. If given enough time, the bloodbug's sac will be restored and it will regain its spit attack.

it's not powerful enough to penetrate power armor. Should they find themselves faced with such heavily armored prey, their range of available attacks becomes limited to largely ineffectual stings and their acid spit

lines.line: Looks like: About two feet long and muddy brown, with six long limbs, one pair of wings and a long pointed proboscis between two compound eyes. The rare red widow bloodbug has a body tinted red.

quoted: Bloodbugs appear to be roughly two feet in length from the head to the tip of the abdomen. Bloodbugs possess muddy brown coloration
bloodbugs possess six long double-jointed limbs, one pair of finely-veined wings and a long, pointed proboscis that extends from between two compound eyes.
Red widow bloodbug
but their bodies are tinted red.

lines.line: Tips: A dead brahmin drained of blood and covered in oversized stings is a sign that bloodbugs are nearby. They cling to trees, walls and ceilings while unaware of you, so a seemingly empty room can hold a whole swarm. Once alerted they spread out and surround you, but if most of the swarm is destroyed before it reaches you the survivors will often retreat.

quoted: Coming across the exsanguinated, gray-skinned husk of a dead brahmin whose body is covered in oversized stings is a significant indicator of knowing there are bloodbugs nearby.

clinging to trees and structures, as well as walls or the ceiling while indoors and unaware of an enemy's presence. This can result in a nasty surprise when the player character enters a seemingly empty room or subway station and suddenly finds themselves in the middle of an entire bloodbug swarm.
Once they are alerted to their victim's presence, they will spread out, surround their prey and attack from multiple directions.
should the majority of the swarm be destroyed before it reaches its prey, the survivors will often retreat.

lines.line: Summary: A big, fast, aggressive mutated scorpion with a poisoned stinger and the ability to burrow. It can deal a large amount of physical and poison damage in only a few hits, and most are found in the Glowing Sea.

quoted: Radscorpions are fast runners, extremely aggressive, extraordinarily well armored and will use their powerful claws and poisoned tails to attack enemies quickly and relentlessly; capable of dealing a large amount of physical and poison damage in only a few hits.
Radscorpions are mostly found within the Glowing Sea.
the ability to burrow underground in seconds

lines.line: Weak points: Their only weak spot is their relatively small face. Weapons with armor-piercing mods, or the Penetrating legendary modifier, help against their armored exoskeletons.

quoted: Their only weak spot is their relatively small face.
Weapons with armor-piercing mods as well as the Penetrating legendary modifier can help to improve the damage output against their armor reinforced exoskeletons.

lines.line: Looks like: A much bigger version of the emperor scorpion, with powerful claws and a poisoned tail. Albino ones are white, deathskull ones are reddish, and glowing ones glow green.

quoted: They originated from the North American emperor scorpion
They have since mutated to become much larger, faster and more venomous than ever before.
powerful claws and poisoned tails
albino radscorpions have a noticeable white color
deathskull radscorpions have a noticeable reddish color
their body is seen glowing green

lines.line: Tips: Fight them from a distance if you can. If you shoot one from afar it burrows and comes up close to you, often in melee range, but standing on rocks or on metallic or wooden surfaces stops them tunnelling there. Deathskull radscorpions level with you, so they cannot be pacified, and they are among the most dangerous creatures in the Commonwealth.

quoted: radscorpions are powerful melee fighters that should be dealt with preferably from a distance

If attacked from afar, they will immediately burrow and emerge close to the player character, often in melee range, provided the ground type can be navigated through by them, so it is possible to avoid being caught unprepared by standing on rocks, or metallic/wooden surfaces before attacking.
These types of radscorpion level with the player character, thus making them impossible to pacify.
Deathskull radscorpions are easily one of the most dangerous creatures one can encounter while exploring the Commonwealth

lines.line: Summary: A ferocious mutated black bear with razor-sharp claws and teeth and a nasty temperament. Wild yao guai attack nearly any other animal or person they meet, deathclaws included.

quoted: yao guai are mutated American black bears. They are one of the more vicious creatures of the wasteland, having razor sharp claws and teeth, and a nasty temperament.
Wild yao guai will attack nearly any other animals or people they encounter, including deathclaws.

lines.line: Weak points: Unlike many other creatures, yao guai do not take increased damage from being shot in the head. The stunted yao guai, with minor malformations, is less of a threat than the other kinds.

quoted: Unlike many other creatures, yao guai do not take increased damage from being shot in the head.
Not as physically imposing as normal yao guai due to minor malformations, past injuries, or arrested development. As a result, they are less of a threat compared to other variants.

lines.line: Looks like: A large mutated bear. Albino ones are much lighter in colour, rabid ones have red welts on their sides and face, and the dusky yao guai is darker with more pronounced scars.

quoted: Yao guai are large, mutated ursines
These yao guai are much lighter in coloration than a typical yao guai due to a genetic defect causing albinism.
it has red welts dominating its sides and face
it has a darker coloration compared to typical yao guai. Additionally, it has more pronounced scars on its body.

lines.line: Tips: Every one of its attacks staggers you, even if you block it, so melee fighting is hard, especially with slow weapons or against a group; time your attacks or you can get stuck in the stagger while it strikes again. They appear as often by day as by night. A dusky yao guai levels with you and is immune to the Animal Friend perk, so it can be an issue at any level.

quoted: the staggering effect on every one of their attacks, even if the player character is quick enough to block them. For this reason, melee fighting against yao guai might be difficult, especially with slow weapons or if fighting against a group. Attacks must be properly timed, otherwise, the player character might get stuck in the stagger effect, giving yao guai enough time to strike once again.
They seem to appear as often during the daytime as they do during the night.
it can be an issue for the player character at any level.
Dusky yao guai level with the player character and are therefore immune to the Animal Friend perk.

lines.line: Summary: Mutated crustaceans of the swamps, coasts and sewers that mostly come in groups and, in most kinds, have a thick shell that is hard to penetrate even with powerful ballistic weapons. They bury themselves in dirt or mud, and from a distance the rounded back of a shell looks like a large smooth rock.

quoted: Mirelurks will bury themselves in dirt or mud, with the only visual indication that they are present is the rounded backs of their shells, which resemble large, smooth rocks from a distance.
Mirelurks are mostly found in groups and thus often utilize strength in numbers.
All mirelurks (excluding mirelurk kings and softshell mirelurks) are protected by a thick shell that is difficult to penetrate, even with powerful ballistic weapons.
Although mirelurks tend to inhabit polluted rivers, coastal waters, and sewers
A mirelurk refers to any one of three mutated crustaceans that dwell in the swamps of the Commonwealth

lines.line: Weak points: The face is unarmored but a small target, and a charging mirelurk often lowers its head to protect it, though the face is exposed once it starts close combat. Its extremities are also more vulnerable than the rest of the body, though not as much as the face.

quoted: The face is unarmored but a small target, and when charging a mirelurk will often lower its head to protect this area. However, the face will inevitably be exposed once the creature commences close combat. Extremities are also more vulnerable than the rest of the body, though not as much as the face.

lines.line: Looks like: Most adult mirelurks have a shell and pincers like a horseshoe crab, and the hunter looks like a lobster. A glowing mirelurk has a glowing underside and a buildup of radiation in its eyestalks.

quoted: Most adult mirelurk variants have shells and pincers resembling those of horseshoe crabs
The hunter variant appears to be a lobster.
their undersides are positively luminescent and a buildup of radiation in its eyestalks gives them a distinct feature even among "glowing" creatures.

lines.line: Tips: Crippling one set of a mirelurk's legs greatly reduces its mobility, and crippling both sets leaves it unable to move or attack, even face to face with you. Mirelurks have no way to protect themselves against mines or any attack from below. Their thick shells make melee hard because they hide their weak points as you strike, so melee weapons with the legendary modifiers penetrating or exterminator's are useful.

quoted: The standard variants of mirelurks will have their mobility greatly reduced should one set of their legs be crippled, crippling both sets of legs will render them completely immobile and they will not be able to attack the player, even while face to face with them.
mirelurks have no way to protect themselves against mines, or any attack from below.
Because of their thick shells, they can be quite hard to defeat in a melee fight, as they tend to hide their weak points when the player character is about to strike
melee weapons with the legendary modifiers "penetrating" (attacks ignore 30% of enemy's Damage Resistance) and "exterminator's" (specific bonus damage to mirelurks) are useful against them.

lines.line: Summary: Hostile gangs found all over the Commonwealth, most thickly around Boston, organised by seniority and ability within the gang. They viciously defend their turf from anything not in their gang.

quoted: The raiders of the Commonwealth are organized into gangs of various sizes and follow a strict hierarchy based on seniority and ability within the gang. They can be found all over the region, but are especially concentrated in Boston, and viciously defend their turf from anything not in their gang
Raiders are hostile characters in the Commonwealth in 2287.

lines.line: Weak points: A common raider is the weakest of the cannon fodder, armed with pipe guns and little health, and survives only a few hits even from basic weapons. Raider veterans are among the toughest, with a high health pool and higher tier weapons, and they are almost never encountered alone.

quoted: A common raider is the weakest of the cannon fodder found in Fallout 4. Armed with pipe guns and little health, they tend to survive only a few hits, even from basic weapons, before succumbing.
They are among the toughest raiders.

Armed with higher tier weapons such as combat rifles, assault rifles and on occasion laser weapons, these enemies are further bolstered by a high health pool and segments of combat armor. They are almost never encountered alone

lines.line: Looks like: Raider scum wear crudely made welded armor and leather armor, wasters and veterans can wear combat armor, and some scavvers wear raider power armor.

quoted: They usually are armed with pipe weapons and crudely made welded armor, and also leather armor.
Wasters are a medium to high level raider. They are the lowest level raider type that can be found with combat armor
these enemies are further bolstered by a high health pool and segments of combat armor.
they are the most common raiders that will spawn in raider power armor.

lines.line: Tips: Psychos are melee-dependent, chem-using raiders that charge you and may throw grenades. Survivalists hide behind objects and blindfire around them, and take well aimed shots when they change position. Like other human enemies, raiders will not chase you into Boston Common: they say the area is deadly and retreat.

quoted: Psychos are melee-dependant chem using raiders that charge at their enemies and may throw grenades.
They will typically hide behind objects and blindfire around them. When changing hiding positions they will take well aimed shots.
Like other human enemies, raiders will refuse to chase the player character into Boston Common, making comments about the area being deadly and retreating.

lines.line: Summary: The heaviest class of combat robot, and one of the rarest and most difficult robots to defeat: fast, agile, heavily armed and tough enough to take a direct hit from a mini nuke. The usual loadout is a missile launcher and a minigun.

quoted: The heaviest class of combat robot in the United States Armed Forces
Sentry bots are some of the rarest and the most difficult robots to defeat - fast, agile, heavily armed and resilient enough to absorb a direct hit from a mini nuke.
with a missile launcher and minigun being the norm

lines.line: Weak points: After engaging you for too long it enters a cooldown, blasting steam out of its back and exposing its dual fusion cores, and hitting the exposed fusion cores is the best way to damage it. With the Penetrator perk you can target and destroy the cores in V.A.T.S. without waiting. Unlike other robots it has no combat inhibitor.

quoted: should a sentry bot engage the player character for too long, they will eventually enter a cooldown period, blasting steam out of their back and exposing their dual fusion cores. Hitting exposed fusion cores is the best way to cause damage to them.
Players having the Penetrator perk need not wait for cooldown and can use V.A.T.S. to target and destroy the fusion cores immediately
unlike other robots it completely lacks a combat inhibitor

lines.line: Looks like: A bulky robot about as tall as a human in power armor and nearly twice as wide, whose torso can rotate independently of its legs. Gunner sentry bots have a faded green tint.

quoted: (on par in height to a human wearing power armor and nearly twice as wide), appear to have a bulkier construction
a sentry bot's entire torso is capable of rotating independently of its legs
they have been reprogrammed by the Gunners and have a faded green tint

lines.line: Tips: If it loses both main weapons it starts its self-destruct sequence and charges you, and it also explodes on death with the force of a mini nuke, so keep your distance. It often charges into close combat if you come too near, which makes melee weapons a poor choice. It drops at least two fusion cores when destroyed.

quoted: After losing both main weapons they will initialize their self-destruct sequence and charge at the player character.
Since they explode on death with the force of a mini nuke
sentry bots often charge into close combat to deliver powerful blows with their arms if one ventures too close, thus deterring attackers from any use of melee weapons.
dropping at least two when they are destroyed

lines.line: Summary: A highly aggressive, fast robot that usually charges you to fight in melee, and most models also carry a laser in the head unit. The basic Assaultron is typically found close to old military bases and roadside transports.

quoted: Assaultrons are highly aggressive and fast in combat, usually preferring the use of their hands and any custom attachments to charge at and attack targets in melee.
Most models of Assaultron house a directed laser weapon in their head unit
The most common variant of Assaultron, typically found close to old military bases and roadside transports.

lines.line: Weak points: The head is almost always behind a retractable layer of armor plating, so headshots do reduced damage, but the plates peel back while the laser charges, which is your chance to hit the head directly. Crippling the head permanently takes away its laser, and destroying its legs removes its speed advantage, though it keeps coming by crawling.

quoted: the head is almost always covered behind a retractable layer of armor plating, allowing Assaultrons to take reduced damage from headshots. However, during the charging sequence, the plates will peel back, giving an opportunity to attack directly; if one is able to cripple the Assaultron's head, it will lose the use of its head laser permanently.

One can remove an Assaultron's speed advantage by targeting and destroying their legs. However, destroying one or both will not stop it completely as it will continue to pursue the target by crawling on the ground.

lines.line: Looks like: A robot with claws for hands and a head unit that gradually becomes surrounded by red electric energy as the laser charges. The dominator variant has a darker finish and twin blade arms.

quoted: their standard claws
the head will gradually become surrounded by red electric energy for around 6-7 seconds if uninterrupted.
A stronger variant with a darker finish and equipped with twin blade arms

lines.line: Tips: The laser takes around 6-7 seconds to charge, then the robot stops in place and fires a constant blast for 2-3 seconds that can seriously injure even a high-level character caught off guard and not behind cover, so get behind cover. A badly damaged but working Assaultron can detonate in an explosion as damaging as a mini nuke, and killing it first gives a normal death. The dominator variant uses a stealth field that stops V.A.T.S. targeting until it is in melee range, and only crippling its torso stops that for good.

quoted: the head will gradually become surrounded by red electric energy for around 6-7 seconds if uninterrupted. Once fully charged, it stops in place and fires a constant laser blast for 2-3 seconds. At full charge and if its target is not behind cover beforehand, the laser can inflict a significant amount of damage in a short time, capable of seriously injuring even a high-level Sole Survivor if caught off-guard.

the robot will activate a "hail mary" attack similar to a sentry bot's meltdown sequence, where the robot will detonate in a localized explosion akin to a mini nuke and just as damaging; killing the Assaultron before they set off the explosion will still result in a normal death.

Unique to this class of Assaultron is its ability to utilize a stealth field akin to a Stealth Boy that prevents being targeted in V.A.T.S. and only reappears when it is in melee range; this ability is only permanently stopped by crippling its torso.

lines.line: Summary: A combat robot, the combat version of the civilian Mister Handy, whose weapon varies from a 10mm submachine gun to a laser weapon or sometimes a flamer. Its 10mm submachine gun is able to shred low-level characters, and even ones in power armor, in seconds.

quoted: A dedicated combat variant of their civilian Mister Handy
the guns can vary from a 10mm submachine gun to a laser weapon or sometimes a flamer, and the damage output also varies between models.
its 10mm submachine gun is capable of shredding low-level player characters and even power armor equipped player characters in seconds.

lines.line: Weak points: It has several targetable sections: the torso, right eye, middle eye, left eye, combat inhibitor, thruster and arms. If an eye is broken its firing accuracy suffers, and disabling the thruster slows it down and removes its strafing ability. Breaking all of the arms makes it attempt a suicide rush on you.

quoted: Mister Gutsy robots have several targetable sections, including the torso, right eye, mid-eye, left eye, combat inhibitor, thruster, and arms. Breaking all of the arms on a Mister Gutsy will result in it attempting a suicide rush on the Sole Survivor.
If any of the eyes are broken, the Mister Gutsy's firing accuracy will suffer and disabling the thruster will slow it down and remove its strafing ability.

lines.line: Looks like: A robot with a torso, three eyes, arms and a thruster, and the words "Mister Handy" written on the back of its body.

quoted: right eye, mid-eye, left eye, combat inhibitor, thruster, and arms
The words "Mister Handy" are written on the backside of their body.

lines.line: Tips: The Killshot perk makes the right and middle eyes easier to hit in V.A.T.S., but not the left eye. A neutral Mister Gutsy turns hostile if you look at it while wearing power armor with a targeting HUD mod installed. The Lieutenant and Major Gutsy carry lasers and have bigger health pools, and the Colonel Gutsy appears once you reach level 46 or higher and levels with you.

quoted: The right and middle eye are targeted more easily with the Killshot perk in V.A.T.S., but not the left eye.
a neutral Mister Gutsy will turn hostile if looked at while the player character is wearing power armor with a targeting HUD mod installed.
it has a moderately accurate (and moderate damage) laser weapon in place of a 10mm submachine gun and a much larger Hit Point pool
now having 200 more Hit Points than its predecessor and a higher damage laser
Colonel Gutsy appears when the player character reaches level 46 or higher. These level with the player character.

lines.line: Summary: The M42 nuclear catapult, a shoulder-mounted launcher that fires mini nukes in a parabolic arc.

quoted: The M42 nuclear catapult, better known as the Fat Man, is a weapon in Fallout 4.
the Fat Man is a shoulder-mounted mini nuke-launcher.
The Fat Man fires in a parabolic arc

lines.line: Uses: A mini nuke travels about 20 yards before it hits when the launcher is held level on even terrain, so angle it upward for anything farther. The experimental MIRV launcher mod, which needs Gun Nut 4 and Science! 4, fires six mini nukes in a cluster that separates in mid-air, which drastically reduces range but raises overall damage and area of effect.

quoted: mini nukes being launched approximately 20 yards before impact when held level to the ground on even terrain, requiring it to be angled upward for any distance outside of this range.
When fitted with the MIRV launcher, it fires six mini nukes in a cluster that separates in mid-air, drastically reducing its range, but increasing its overall damage and area of effect.
An experimental modification.
Gun Nut: 4 Science!: 4

lines.line: Tips: From a long way off the projectile makes a loud whistling noise, a sign to get to cover. A mini nuke is sometimes a dud and only does physical damage if it hits. The MIRV mod can detonate right at your feet, most often when you fire in a direction lower than where you stand. A Fat Man in the main stockpile area of the Federal ration stockpile respawns.

quoted: When fired from a long enough distance, the projectile makes a loud whistling noise (similar to the cartoon noise for falling from the sky or the sound that bombs make after being dropped) which indicates one should get to cover.
There is a chance that a mini nuke fired by the Fat Man will be a dud and only cause physical damage to a target if they are hit by the dud.

When firing with the experimental MIRV modification, there is a chance that it will detonate right at one's feet, even if they are firing away from themselves. This most often happens when the player fires in a direction lower than their current position.
Federal ration stockpile - In the main stockpile area
This Fat Man also respawns.

lines.line: Summary: A football-sized tactical nuclear warhead, as rare as it is powerful, made to be fired from a nuclear catapult weapon.

quoted: The mini nuke is a football-sized tactical nuclear warhead designed for use in a nuclear catapult weapon in Fallout 4.
A small, football-sized nuclear bomb, as rare as it is powerful.

lines.line: Uses: They are the ammunition for the Fat Man launcher. A variant, the Nuka-nuke, is fired by the Nuka-nuke launcher from the Nuka-World add-on.

quoted: the Fat Man is a shoulder-mounted mini nuke-launcher.
Nuka-nuke, deployed by the Nuka-nuke launcher in the Nuka-World add-on.

lines.line: Tips: Mini nukes are commonly found in the region, sometimes carried by super mutant suiciders, and they appear more often as fixed loot in certain locations, respawning often when you are not playing in Survival mode. Kill a suicider without hitting its right arm and before it can detonate its mini nuke, and you can loot it from the corpse. Weapon emporiums built in settlements occasionally sell them, and rarely an ammo box holds three or four, depending on your Scrounger perk rank. In Survival mode each one weighs 12 units.

quoted: Mini nukes are commonly found in the region. They are sometimes carried by super mutant suiciders. They appear more frequently as fixed loot in certain locations, respawning often when not playing in Survival mode.
If it is killed without hitting its right arm and before it can detonate the held mini nuke, it can be looted off its corpse afterward.
Mini nukes can be bought from weapon emporiums built in settlements.
Mini nukes can (rarely) be found in ammo boxes. When found, they will contain either 3 or 4 mini nukes, depending on the player character's Scrounger perk rank.
In Survival mode, mini nukes weigh in at 12 units each

lines.line: Summary: A heavy weapon that fires any junk items you load into its hopper, such as desk fans, tin cans, teddy bears and Nuka-Cola bottles.

quoted: A heavy "ballistic" weapon that fires any junk items loaded into its hopper, e.g. desk fans, tin cans, teddy bears, Nuka-Cola bottles, etc.

lines.line: Uses: Fired items can be picked up again, so it has theoretically unlimited ammunition, though about 10% of the time an item is lost on contact with the enemy. A shot charged for about 1 second does more damage. The shots drop sharply beyond pistol range, so it is impractical at long range.

quoted: fired items can be picked up after being shot, making this a ranged weapon with theoretically unlimited ammunition. In practice, however, items will (about 10% of the time) be lost upon contact with the enemy
the Junk Jet does a higher amount of damage if the shot is charged for approximately 1 second
projectiles follow a parabolic trajectory, dropping significantly beyond effective pistol range. This makes the weapon impractical for long-range fire

lines.line: Tips: The loaded junk still counts against your Carry Weight, so a light item such as steel, or pre-War money, which weighs nothing, makes good ammunition. Junk is also useful for building and crafting in settlements, so the choice is which items are worth firing instead of keeping in the workshop. You find the weapon in the ArcJet Systems building, on the table in the rocket control room, which can only be entered after starting the quest Call to Arms; its terminal is Advanced-locked.

quoted: the contained junk still counts against Carry Weight.
One that works well is steel
an item that has zero Carry Weight such as pre-War money.
collecting junk in Fallout 4 becomes a matter of figuring out which items are worth using as ammunition for the Junk Jet over storing them in the workshop for use with building and crafting
The weapon can be found inside the ArcJet Systems building, on the table in the rocket control room. Entering the rocket control room is only possible after starting Call to Arms
Accessing the room itself requires getting past an Advanced-locked terminal

lines.line: Summary: A consumable soft drink in a clear bottle of glowing blue liquid, which gets its glow from the radioactive isotope strontium-90.

quoted: Nuka-Cola Quantum is a consumable soft drink in Fallout 4.
A clear bottle with glowing blue liquid inside (achieved through the use of the radioactive isotope Strontium-90.)

lines.line: Uses: It replenishes a large number of hit points for a drink, 40 per second for 10 seconds, and its listing shows +400 hit points, +100 action points and +5 radiation. It is non-addictive, and in Survival mode it counts as a caffeinated drink.

quoted: Nuka-Cola Quantum replenishes a large number of Hit Points for a drink: 40 HP per second for 10 seconds.
+400 Hit Points
+100 Action Points
+5 Radiation
Nuka-Cola Quantum in Fallout 4 is non-addictive.
In Survival mode, it counts as a caffeinated drink.

lines.line: Tips: A bottle is also a crafting component, for weaponized Nuka-Cola Quantum ammo, the Nuka-nuke and the Nuka-grenade among others. Bottles respawn in areas after you pick them up. A rare Vault-Tec lunchbox (one with stickers) or a Nuka-Cola lunchbox can drop one, and raider gang tribute chests have a 25% chance of holding one.
